line: His Olympic marathon took over 54 years. Meanwhile, he married and had six children.
After 30, muscle slowly fades. Training and good food can change that a lot.
credit: E. Volpi et al. · Curr Opin Clin Nutr, 2004

line: A nun began training at 48. At 82, she crossed an Ironman finish line.
No time? Five to ten minutes of slow running daily went with longer life.
credit: D. C. Lee et al. · J Am Coll Cardiol, 2014

line: Small or big, whatever task you find, give it all your strength.
And yoga itself means skill in action: doing each task well.
At 105 he sprinted 100 metres in Kyoto. His secret: health comes first.
And health starts at the table: stop eating at about 80% full.
Lifelong skiers aged 80 and over had fitness like ordinary men 40 years younger.
credit: S. Trappe et al. · J Appl Physiol, 2013

line: One day of full effort is better than a hundred lazy years. Practise today.
credit: The Buddha · Dhammapada 112, tr. Max Müller
